svg.title: Wave lines recorded for the pen
svg.desc: A coordinate diagram, not a view of the physical machine. The origin is at the diagram's top left; positive X follows the 594 mm rail and positive Y spans 432 mm. Paper and drawing are placed within those coordinates. The physical starting corner must match the driver's motor directions.

g.text: Wave lines recorded for the pen
Coordinate view. Match X and Y to the real machine.
Start at its known origin. A different corner changes the job.
